consult.summary: קרן במצב טוב, והמחיר בעלייה. אין כרגע סיבה מיוחדת לחכות. יש גם סימנים לעלייה קרובה.

about: In seeking to track the performance of the index, the fund employs a replication strategy. It generally invests substantially all, but at least 95%, of its total assets in the securities comprising the index. The index includes companies that have been identified as Consumer Staples companies by the GICS®. It is non-diversified.
